messages:
celine: Hey all — PR 19765 is up: routing handshake + small eviction safety net. Need runtime + infra + security eyes. Hoping to merge in the next merge window (canary after merge). TL;DR: adds fallback route, tightens TLS config, and adjusts eviction threshold. PTAL when you have a sec. https://github.com/redwood/pr/19765 :thumbsup:
ajay: pinging @runtime oncall and @eng-infra for perf/eviction concerns. Quick note: does this change affect our continuous batching behavior?
tom: I skimmed the handler change. Can you paste the snippet that adjusts the eviction threshold?
celine: sure — snippet below:
```
// lower eviction reserve to avoid stalls when cache is hot
evictionConfig.reservePercent = Math.max(5, previousReserve - 10);
// fallback routing: prefer local pool, then dedicated, then hosted
routePolicy.order = ["local", "dedicated", "hosted"];
```
celine: Tests added for route order and a unit to assert TLS cipher list includes AEAD ciphers.
ravi: I'm OOO until EOD but can give security a pass tomorrow morning. If runtime/infra have major perf concerns, don't block on me — we can do a follow-up patch.
maria: quick question — can we canary to a small customer subset only? If yes, I'm +1 after security thumbs. :+1:
security-bot: Security checklist: 1) TLS ciphers present (AEAD) — yes 2) No plaintext credential logging — scan ok 3) KMS access pattern unchanged — need to confirm with infra 4) Audit events emitted for fallback routing decisions — missing (please add)
celine: thanks — will add audit emit for fallback decision.
ajay: runtime note: the change to routePolicy.order will slightly increase tail latency for cold KV cache reads in local pool. Suggest canarying with burst limit off, monitor p50/p95.
tom: also add a comment near the eviction tweak referencing the reason (avoid stalls) so future reviewers don't revert it blindly.
celine: good call — will add comment + audit emit. Who can own the runtime sign-off? @ajay can you nominate someone if you can't?
ajay: I can take a quick pass later today, but @kevin-runtime would be best for deeper perf — kevin, can you look tomorrow morning?
kevin-runtime: I'll take it tomorrow AM. ETA 10:30PT.
maria: once security and runtime sign off, can someone grab a merge slot? Our next merge window is 14:00PT but I can do a late slot if needed.
celine: aiming for 14:00PT canary window. If all thumbs in by 12:00PT I'll queue it.
security-bot: reminder: please add the audit events before merging.
celine: ack. I'll push a tiny follow-up commit for the audit event + comment within 30m.
deploy-bot: CI passed on commit 8a7c3f7. Staging deploy scheduled after merge.
ajay: thanks — I'll re-review after the follow-up commit. If nothing major, I'm OK with an A/B canary (5% traffic) for 24h.
celine: perfect. tagging this for visibility. please react with :eyes: when you've read.
